mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. zero).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting equity investors to anticipate reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. zero).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0% and housing starts fall below 600,000 units, it signals a dual deterioration in labor and housing demand, triggering a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0 AND HOUST < 600 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. zero).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), a CPIAUCSL index above 225.0 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to raise rates further and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225.0 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. zero).

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 600,000 units signals weak residential demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced construction activity and lower consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 600 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. zero).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 93.5 signals weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 93.5 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. zero).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 0.25% and unemployment exceeds 9.0%, it signals a stagflationary environment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate policy constraints.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.25 AND UNRATE > 9.0 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. zero).

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales level below 390,000 million dollars signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS < 390000 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. zero).
